series.name: Vertex HVS LCD (HVS-12/24/30/5014SCC, HVP-5015SCC)
series.notes: Vertex zero-padded Fault 00–08. Full user manuals exist on Scribd (HVS-1214, HVS-5014) but are Cloudflare-blocked — fault table unread = top offline unlock. Do not merge with legacy bare Fault-N without manual confirmation. No official homage.pk download.

meaning.en: Fault 00 on Vertex-class LCD — repair videos exist; meaning not published.
meaning.ur: Vertex-class LCD par Fault 00 — repair videos hain; meaning publish nahi.

solutions.en: Power off (WAPDA + battery leads); wait 2–5 min; power on once
solutions.ur: Power off karein (WAPDA + battery leads); 2–5 minute wait; ek baar on

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician diagnosis required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician diagnosis zaroori

notes.en: Low confidence: Fault 00 on Vertex-class LCD comes from repair videos only — the Vertex manual fault table was not readable. Verify on your model.
